init.title: RTE account (optional)
init.description: Tempo colors come from RTE's public calendar, which needs no account. If it stops working, the integration can use RTE's official API instead: create a free application for the "Tempo Like Supply Contract" API on data.rte-france.com and enter its credentials. Leave both fields empty to use the public calendar only.

tempo_unavailable.title: Tempo colors can't be updated
tempo_unavailable.description:
RTE's public Tempo calendar hasn't answered properly since {since} ({error}), so the hours of {title} after that wait to be costed.

If RTE changed this calendar, the official API takes over: create a free application for the "Tempo Like Supply Contract" API on data.rte-france.com, then enter its credentials in the options of {title}. The waiting hours are costed as soon as colors arrive again.

tempo_unavailable_official.title: Tempo colors can't be updated
tempo_unavailable_official.description: Neither RTE's public Tempo calendar nor its official API has answered properly since {since} ({error}), so the hours of {title} after that wait to be costed. They are costed as soon as colors arrive again; nothing needs to be done if RTE is only down for a while.

prices_unavailable.title: Regulated prices can't be updated
prices_unavailable.description: The regulated prices couldn't be downloaded from data.gouv.fr since {since} ({error}). {title} keeps the prices it already has; a price change published since then isn't applied until the download works again.

rte_credentials_refused.title: RTE refuses the credentials
rte_credentials_refused.description: RTE's official API refused the client ID and secret set in the options of {title}. Check the application on data.rte-france.com and enter its credentials again, or clear both fields to use the public calendar only.
